title: Esaad Card for Golden Visa Holders: Complete Guide
description: The Esaad Card gives UAE Golden Visa holders big savings and perks. Learn how to get yours and enjoy exclusive benefits!

breadcrumb.name: Esaad Card for Golden Visa Holders: Complete Guide

contentHtml:
Getting a Golden Visa in the UAE gives you access to special benefits, but numerous visa holders are still looking for more. The Esaad card is the answer. It goes from being a basic discount scheme to the exclusive lifestyle amenities that really make living better in the Emirates.

Several people who have a UAE Golden Visa don’t know that they automatically qualify for this card, and they lose thousands of dirhams in various activities.

This article will clear up any confusion and help you get the most out of your Esaad card for golden visa holders, so you can start enjoying the amazing privileges you deserve.

What is the Esaad Card?

It is a government-sponsored Esaad privilege card that gives you exclusive perks and markdowns. Cardholders and their families can save money on over seven thousand brands in several countries.

These brands include everything from food and retail purchases to medical services, getaways, and entertainment.

Esaad Card Purpose

The Esaad Card is a Dubai Police scheme that provides people with various facilities for an adequate reason. “You Made People Happy, So We Must Make You Happy” is its tagline. It shows that the government wants to reward the cardholders in the UAE.

Why Golden Visa Holders Get Accessibility

It’s a misconception that this card initially worked only for government workers. However, the Esaad card for golden visa holders is available as well. The evolution shows that they are valuable to the UAE’s economic system and society.

Eligibility for the Esaad Card

Who is eligible for the ESAAD card? Most people consider the Esaad Card to be accessible only to government workers, but that’s not true. The card is also available to other categories, including seniors and individuals with disabilities, in addition to UAE Golden Visa holders.

People who can get the Esaad Card besides Golden Visa holders are: Dubai government workers, army and civil servant retirees, Individuals of Determination, and seniors.

The card has also been given to some people on five-year resident visas, such as those with real estate visas, to show that they are committed to living in the UAE for a long time.

Criteria for the Esaad Card as a Golden Visa Holder

You are in luck! If you have a Golden Visa, you consequently qualify for the Esaad Card. You are not required to show any more proof or apply independently since it comes with your visa.

The best aspect? Your dependents are also part of your family visa in the UAE. They all get to enjoy these incredible privileges.

Esaad Card Privileges for Golden Visa Holders

Your Golden Visa journey gets even better with your Esaad card discounts list. You can save more cash on everything from premium medical treatments in top hospitals to airline tickets with leading airlines.

The card also gives you access to special deals on dining, shopping, recreational activities, and academic pursuits, which makes living in the UAE easier and worthwhile. It is a crucial part of the larger UAE Golden Visa benefits in a package.

Travel & Flight Discounts

As a Golden Visa holder, you can get exclusive travel discounts! The Esaad Card can help you save more cash on trips. These bargains are a great deal for people who travel a lot.

They lower the cost for professional trips and family getaways, making every trip less costly and more fun.

Retail Discounts and Savings

With your Esaad Card, you can get great deals on shopping and retail. Premium stores have extensive sales on gadgets, with discounts of up to seventy percent. You can also discover fantastic prices on apparel and expensive goods at stores.

Medical Services and Discounts

Getting good healthcare is one of the most essential Esaad card benefits. ESAAD cardholders can get ten to twenty percent off of appointments, tests for diagnosis, and surgical procedures at large medical facilities.

The card also gives you and your family exceptional savings on health insurance policies and pharmacy expenditures.

Lodging, Dine-Out, & Recreational Activities

People with a Golden Visa and an Esaad Card can save more money on the most popular recreational activities. You can save from thirty percent to fifty percent off on stays at luxurious accommodations and lodges.

With the Esaad card offers list, you can also get fantastic deals at renowned dining spots and at famous theaters.

Family Perks on ESAAD Card

These benefits are also available to family members of Golden Visa holders. Life with family in the UAE is less costly since educational institutions offer discounts on education, and health and wellness centers offer discounts on other services. These are incredible reasons to retire in the UAE.

Getting the Esaad Card for Golden Visa Holders

How to get an Esaad card for a golden visa? As a Golden Visa holder, getting your card is a simple, online registration process. All you have to do is navigate the official Esaad website and sign up with your Emirates ID.

Various individuals have issues when they use the wrong third-party sites or don’t have all the required information they need. To ensure your activation goes smoothly, follow the official instructions and provide the right credentials.

Verify Eligibility

To ensure the Esaad card eligibility for a Golden visa, such as an investor, proprietor, or competent professional. Your Emirates identification card is the most essential thing.

It is connected to your visa status in the government’s system, which instantly validates that you are eligible.

Collect Necessary Documents

How to apply for an Esaad card? It is easy to get your Esaad Card. You will require a current photo, a passport copy, and a valid Emirates identification card.

You can sign up on the official Esaad site with your Emirates identification number, which promptly validates your Golden Visa status. It simplifies the procedure, and you don’t have to send in any extra documentation.

Online Esaad Card Registration

How to get an Esaad card? Go to the official ESAAD.AE website to get your Esaad Card. Don’t work with unofficial agents.

To start the registration process, simply fill out the short online form with correct details, such as your Emirates identification number, full name, email address, and phone number.

Activate the Card

You will send in your application after you finish the form. The positive aspect of the Esaad card for golden visa holders is that they don’t have to pay anything.

You will get a message once your application is approved. You can then activate your card online using the official Esaad mobile application or the official website.

Esaad Card Promotion List and Savings

Your Esaad Card gives you access to a world of special deals. The card lets you get the best deals on everything from luxury lodging to routine purchases.

Golden Visa holders may take advantage of these and numerous other great bargains from multiple top brands.

Trips & Accommodation Offers

Your Esaad Card makes travel easier, whether you’re going on an expensive holiday or just going to work every day. Get as much as fifty percent off stays at high-end hotels and lodges.

Also, you may obtain substantial reductions on flights with premier airlines, which makes every trip more enjoyable.

Shopping and Lifestyle

The Esaad Card will make your purchasing experience better. Premium stores have devices on sale for a seventy percent discount.

Also, get exclusive deals on designer apparel and accessories from top brands, which gives you a greater experience on every purchase.

Education and Institutional Discounts

With your Esaad Card, you may enjoy incredible family-friendly perks! You and your kids can get as much as forty percent off school expenses and eighty percent off university tuition.

It makes it simpler and more affordable for your family members to get an excellent education in the UAE.

Why Every Golden Visa Holder Gets an Esaad Card

Every Golden Visa holder must acquire the Esaad Card. It’s not just about the cash you save; it’s a sign of privilege.

The card makes your visa more valuable and provides you with an array of unique perks that make your life lucrative, prestigious, and easy in the UAE.

Improved Lifestyle

The Esaad Card will revolutionize your life in the UAE. It reduces your cost of living more, and you can save thousands of dirhams on anything from routine needs to expensive products. It also opens up exceptional experiences.

Great Status

The Esaad Card shows that you are a crucial component of the UAE’s economy. The card not only gives you privileges at home, but it also gives you special recognition and perks in multiple countries, showing how well-known you are around the world.

Apply for Esaad Card: Quick Summary

Here’s a basic summary:

  • You must have a valid Golden Visa in the UAE to be eligible.
  •  One of the basic Esaad card requirements is a valid Emirates identification card.
  • Sign up for an account on the official Esaad website using your Emirates identification number and other personal details.
  • Once your card is authorized, you can activate it through the Esaad mobile application or website.

Apply now to get your exceptional lifestyle perks!

Final Words

Don’t forget about the incredible Esaad Card. This complimentary benefit really changes the Golden Visa experience to a premium life standard. The card simplifies life in the UAE by giving people access to several discounts and savings each year.

So the Esaad Card is vital for everyone who has a Golden Visa. Without a doubt, the Esaad Card is one of the most valuable UAE golden visa benefits.

To avoid issues, ensure to utilize the official Esaad website to sign up exclusively. If you are seeking assistance with your visa, trip, and more, you may choose to hire a professional agency.

Royal Visa Consultancy Firm’s main objective is to make the process of getting a visa and residency easier.

FAQs

How Can I Apply for An Esaad Card as A Golden Visa Holder?

Getting an Esaad card registration is easy. Go to the official Esaad website and sign up with your Emirates identification number. It will instantly prove that you are eligible.

Who Can Get the Esaad Card?

Many people don’t realize that the Esaad Card is available to more people than they assume. It also applies to people who work for the Dubai government, retirees from the military and civilian life, People of Determination, and retirees.

What Prerequisites Do You Need for The Esaad Card?

You will need to send in the appropriate documentation, which generally includes evidence of identity.

Is the Esaad Card Free for People Who Have a Golden Visa?

Yes, those with a Golden visa can get a free ESAAD card in Dubai without paying anything.

How Can I Get an Esaad Card Activated?

For Esaad card activation, you can get the mobile application from the app store and enter your work ID and Emirates identification number.

Should My Family Utilize the Perks of My Esaad Card?

Yes, workers who have the ESAAD card and their family members can use the card’s privileges.
